text:
sasha: Quick thread to finalize the benchmark narrative for the launch. Need a succinct latency+cost headline, 3 charts, and a short X post. Can eng confirm numbers?

anya: Proposed headline: "Lower per-token cost, same latency guarantees." Add a supporting lab stat in the blog.

miguel: Agree but keep the multiplier conservative until we have verified runs. Suggest: "Lab sweep shows up to ~1.6x infra savings at matched P95 (256 tokens)" with a footnote.

jamal: I'll run a reproducible sweep: models redwood-4b-fp16, redwood-4b-q8, redwood-4b-q4; seq 64/256/512; batches 1/4/16. Metrics p50/p95 and tokens/sec.

olivia: GTM checklist: landing one-liner + 3 bullets, webinar CTA capturing avg tokens/min, UTM params utm_campaign=bench_launch_2024&utm_medium=social, SDR tag "bench_estimate".

benchbot: Auto: sweep job queued by jamal. Tracker: https://redwood.share/bench/launch-2024. Results will be posted. :gear:

jamal: Sweep complete. Quick summary: redwood-4b-q8 shows ~1.6x lower infra cost at matched P95 for seq=256 batch=4; gap narrows at 512. CSV uploaded to tracker. Lab GPU price used = $3.10/hr, infra overhead = 12%.

miguel: That supports the narrative. Add parenthetical "lab pricing" and a note that Dedicated customers see more savings at scale.

anya: Chart set: 1) P95 latency vs throughput (series per variant), 2) cost per 100k tokens (hosted vs dedicated vs baseline), 3) tail-latency heatmap. Social tile: compact cost bar + short line.

designbot: We'll produce three visual variants: hero chart, compact badge, and methodology slide with command snippet. Palette: product blues + neutrals.

olivia: Draft landing blurb: "Redwood Inference: predictable latency SLOs and lower per-token cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." CTA: "Get estimate".

jamal: Repro command for methodology slide:
```bash
python tools/bench_sweep.py \
  --models redwood-4b-fp16,redwood-4b-q8,redwood-4b-q4 \
  --seq 64,256,512 \
  --batch 1,4,16 \
  --metrics p50,p95,tokens_per_sec \
  --out results/launch_sweep.csv
```

benchbot: Slide export uploaded: https://redwood.share/slides/bench-launch-v1. Feedback comments enabled.

miguel: I'll review the blog draft for technical accuracy and provide a short engineer quote about batching/kv-caching.

anya: Social copy (X): "New benchmark: lower inference costs without sacrificing latency SLOs. See lab results + get a personalized estimate. [link] #inference #llm" (under 220 chars)

olivia: Routing rule: tag leads with "bench_estimate"; if avg tokens/min > 5k or monthly tokens > 10M route to enterprise-sdr. I'll add the UTM links.

sasha: Next steps: jamal finalize methodology note (today), design deliver charts (EOD tomorrow), olivia+anya draft blog/landing (tomorrow morning), internal review 1600PT tomorrow. Flag risky claims here. :rocket:
